Image Description: A blurry, white number "3" against a gray background.

This image depicts a stylized white numeral "3" with a unique, hand-drawn appearance, featuring a curved top section and a flat bottom section. The font is somewhat irregular, with uneven edges and an asymmetrical shape. The number is centered in the frame and dominates the entire image. The background is a solid, uniform gray color, providing a clean and simple contrast to the stylized number.
